forbidden_substitutions: uniform map silently labeled empirical chr22
real 3720746 variants treated as simulated S
unrecovered whole-chromosome span assumed from title
chromosome22.interval_rule: Freeze one explicit interval entirely within authenticated chr22 map support, rebase bp and cumulative genetic map to zero, no extrapolation; use identical interval and map in simulation and Relate.
chromosome22.length_definition: L=end_bp-start_bp; unknown until interval is frozen

demography.BAA_event: deleted; see qualified marginal-law argument in readiness manifest
demography.provenance: Pinned AP simulate.py graph/size recipe with new sample dates/counts and the unused BAA branch deleted.
demography.simulation_model: standard coalescent, diploid SampleSets, discrete genome, one independent parent per registered ancestry/mutation seed

fitting.AP: Preserve released Keras six-head architecture/native optimizer and five epochs, add validation-loss checkpoint selection within those five epochs and disclosed four-founder probability projection.
fitting.ARGMix: Preserve current-release transformer+BiGRU settings (15 refs, 0 ancestors, log2 cap14); set four-class ontology and pin a finite optimizer/batch/epoch/context configuration in successor before execution. No paper-model claim.
fitting.model_selection: No test tuning; save/select minimum validation loss under each disclosed finite fit recipe.
fitting.shared_training_budget: Exactly the shared 500000 target rows; no extra independently sampled native training targets.

misspecification_proposed_rule.chronology: Reject an entire parameter dictionary and redraw until every event acts on an active population, all admixtures are older than relevant samples, downstream ancestral events are older than contributing events, all admixtures remain younger than fixed census350, and all founder divergences remain older than census350.
misspecification_proposed_rule.draws: Use each existing parent demography_perturbation seed, with sorted parameter-name order; magnitude continuous Uniform(0.01,0.50) for sizes and Uniform(0.01,0.25) for event times. Size/split signs independent equiprobable; admixture times older only.
misspecification_proposed_rule.next_required_step: Implement this deterministic draw/validation source, materialize five dictionaries and hash them before any biological generation; report this as a new OOD distribution rather than the exact paper draws.
misspecification_proposed_rule.parameters: Perturb every retained initial population size and every retained admixture/split time separately; census and sample dates remain fixed. No admixture-proportion perturbation.
misspecification_proposed_rule.rounding: Retain real-valued sizes/event times; do not round. Input sample ages remain integer.

mutations_and_observation.error_model: New policy: independently flip each haploid 0/1 allele at each simulated mutation site with Bernoulli(0.001), in all eight cohorts, once per parent. This is not claimed to be the paper's unspecified genotype-error mechanism.
mutations_and_observation.external_truth: Retain four-founder lineage at census 350 per selected haplotype/coordinate in a segregated scoring/supervision artifact; never derive an observed feature from it.
mutations_and_observation.filtering: Keep observed biallelic segregating sites after error, drop invariant sites; retain known phase and record the ordered variant manifest.

relate.extra_postprocessing: none unless explicitly added to the frozen prospective command manifest
relate.required_before_execution: Record exact argv, executable/installation hashes, seed, mutation/branch estimation defaults or explicit options, and verified ID mapping. One shared inferred tree output per parent.

roster.age_provenance: New fixed integer-generation design, inspired by upstream 28-year fixed-date convention; not recovered ARGMix age distribution. The older-NF proxy is not an identified or dated Iceman.

cohorts.age_generations_policy: 158 at 180; one separately named synthetic older-NF proxy at 185

roster.donor_policy: All six donor cohorts, excluding both haplotypes of the focal diploid. PostNeolithic/Present have no cohort-identity donor channels. NF/Yam remain donors for other focal diploids.
roster.identity: Synthetic IDs cohort_0000 etc.; two explicitly paired haplotypes per diploid. No claim of recovered real people.
roster.stable_order: cohort order above, synthetic diploid index, then haplotype 0/1; adapters must map actual simulator/Relate order by IDs rather than assume ranges.

shared_targets.coordinate: Physical midpoint of the inferred-tree half-open interval; use the same coordinate for every method and right-continuous truth lookup.
shared_targets.donor_ties: For the prospective nearest-reference adapter, raw inferred TMRCA ties break by stable roster haplotype ID after per-focal diploid exclusion.
shared_targets.failure_policy: If support has fewer than 100000 pairs or any required query cohort has zero selected rows, stop. Any interval/budget change must be frozen before observed/label/model inspection; never silently resample/cycle rows.
shared_targets.selection: Using registered sampler seed, uniformly sample 100000 distinct (tree_index, query_haplotype) pairs without replacement from the support; no ancestry-truth/cohort-conditioned selection. Serialize exact row order once for all methods.
shared_targets.sequence_model_context: Native ARGMix may use observed-only neighboring context from its own parent/split, with losses/scoring masked to shared targets. No truth or labels outside allowed training supervision enter context.
shared_targets.skip_provenance: New unambiguous rule; not a recovered interpretation of paper skip language.
shared_targets.support: All eligible query haplotypes crossed with eligible positive-span inferred trees.
shared_targets.train_tree_selection: Zero-based inferred tree index i with i modulo 10 == 0.
shared_targets.val_tree_selection: Zero-based inferred tree index i with i modulo 100 == 0.

splits_and_seeds.parent_names_note: Old published_recon_* identifiers are registry identifiers only; outputs must be titled prospective, not exact reproduction.
splits_and_seeds.rule: Reuse its 14 parents and all 77 new deterministic seeds without minting a duplicate registry. These are prospective seeds, not paper seeds.
